learning_outcomes.text: Solve spatial problems and conceive technical forms, characteristic of creative industrial project and design activities.
Apply CAD tools in the Industrial Project and Design process.
Apply graphic expression techniques when addressing common or specialized subjects in their study plan.
Express and communicate technical ideas and forms, own or external, through freehand sketches, technical drawings, and models created with drawing instruments and CAD software.
Understand the concepts of Topography and Topographic Drawing.
Prepare professional graphic technical documentation in the context of technical industrial project and design activities.
Prepare professional graphic technical documentation in the context of technical constructive project and design activities and topographic representation of terrain.

Analysis, synthesis, and individual study of information and documentation

assessment_methods.method: Exam (long answer and experimental work tests)

assessment_rules: Continuous assessment practices are recoverable by submitting corrected or complementary work. The exam is recoverable through an objective test in the recovery call. For the exam activity, if the minimum of 4 out of 10 is not met in any evaluated part, the maximum final grade will be 4.9 out of 10. If the minimum of 5 out of 10 is not met in any evaluation activity, the maximum final grade will be 4.9 out of 10.
